title: Risotto with Peppers
blurb: A simple risotto with sweet peppers that soften into the creamy rice. The peppers add colour and a gentle sweetness.
steps: Cut the pepper in half, remove the seeds and white membrane, then cut the flesh into 1 cm squares.
Warm the stock in a small pan and keep it at a gentle simmer.
Heat the olive oil in a wide pan over medium heat, add the rice and stir for a minute until the grains look glossy.
Add the pepper pieces and stir them through the rice.
Add a ladleful of hot stock and stir until it is absorbed, then continue adding stock a ladleful at a time, stirring frequently, until the rice is tender and creamy.
Remove from the heat, stir in the Parmesan and season with salt to taste.
